title: Josh Hokit vows no regret over vulgar Michelle Obama remarks ahead of UFC title fight
summary_full: UFC heavyweight Josh Hokit has refused to apologise for his controversial remarks about former US first lady Michelle Obama, insisting he has no regrets despite widespread backlash. The undefeated fighter defended making the comments at the White House, claiming the controversy boosted his profile. Hokit now turns his attention to Ciryl Gane and his first UFC heavyweight title opportunity at UFC 334.
